title: Count Equal and Divisible Pairs in an Array
goal: Count equal-value index pairs whose index product is divisible by k.
strategy: Check each pair with the earlier index strictly smaller. Values must match and their zero-based index product must be a multiple of k; index zero makes the product zero.

edgeCases: A divisor of one accepts every equal-value pair
Distinct values have no equal pair
Index zero makes its product divisible by any positive k
